第13章 你救世歌姬吧给爷死（第1页）
声音之大，力量之强，令众人都为之颤抖。
葛红秋的嘴角都被打裂了，发出了凄厉的惨叫声。
“啊啊啊…你这垃圾，你在干什么？”
“我在让你这个贱人闭嘴！觉得爽吗，哈哈哈…”
对方彻底癫狂，一直以来，周通都宠着她哄着她，才让她养成了目空一切的性格。
如今周通对她的态度急转直下，这让她瞬间暴怒，张牙舞爪的扑了上来。
“呵呵呵…你还真把自己当盘菜了，对你好的时候，你说什么都行，现在我不在乎你，你连屁都不是！给爷死！”
周通哪怕修为大跌，现在的实力也不是对方可以相比的，他直接重手出击，一脚踹在了对方的腹部。
葛红秋被打的眼球突出，整个人如同破麻袋般倒飞出去，凄惨的摔在了地上。
这一幕，深深的刺激到了一旁的姜玉瑶。
“大胆，你知道我们之间的差距吗？你现在只是一个叛徒，跟我们相比一个在天一个在地，对你而言，我们就如同神明一样！”
姜玉瑶怒吼道，她要让周通认清楚自己的身份，这里没有他放肆的余地。
“你他妈就救世歌姬吧！你也去死！”
周通彻底放开了，直抒胸襟，毫不给面子，一把攥住了姜玉瑶的头发，按着她脑袋狠狠的朝着地面砸去！
“对，想让我放手，你就是在做梦！”
众人目瞪口呆，从未见过如此暴虐的周通，有的更是忍不住颤抖了起来。
只见空间扭曲，莫流苏，陈灵儿和和唐七突然降临于此。

周通这才停下手上的动作，面色平淡的扫视的这些人。
“敢在这里逞凶，你已经犯了死罪！”
小妖女走上前来，与之针锋相对道：“这两个贱人挑衅合欢宗在先，就算是被打死也是咎由自取，你若不服，就去问我师尊！”
此话一出，众人顿时就想起了慕容雅那个女魔头，忍不住打了个寒颤。
尽管都说那女人已经油尽灯枯了，却依旧没有人敢去冒犯她。
“周通，你太肆意妄为了！我对你很失望。”
陈灵儿趾高气昂的说道：“竟然跟魔女混在了一起，你还真是自甘堕落！”
“你算个毛，也配对我说教？”周通不屑道。
陈灵儿扬起娇俏的脸：“真是幼稚，你对师妹们出手不就是想引起我的注意吗，现在我站在这里了，你敢打我一下吗！”
此话一出，周围的人全都目瞪口呆，他们从未听过如此要求。
陈灵儿却满脸高傲，眉眼之间，尽是俯视之态。
之所以敢这样，正是因为她有恃无恐，她能清楚地感觉到，曾经的周通是对她暗怀情愫的。
如若不然，周通怎么可能会在百宗大会中抛弃小妖女，无条件地赶到她身边？
如果不是喜欢，周通又岂能主动舍弃修炼的时间，费心费力的帮她钻研剑谱，让她成为年轻一辈剑道第一人？
如果不是因为爱慕，周通又怎会舍得消耗灵气为她灌顶？
然而那又如何？她本来就是清冷的性子，清雅如雪莲，不食人间烟火。
而且她也看不起周通那没有尊严，卑躬屈膝的谨慎模样，在她眼里，只有意气风发，天姿横行的小师弟才是真正的天才，顶天立地的存在！
哪怕现在，她都以为周通是在欲擒故纵，心中对其更加鄙视。
在众人的注视下，周通笑意温柔的挽起了衣袖，对着那张洁白的脸狠狠的扇了下去！

Chapter 13 Save the singer and die (page 1)
The sound was so loud and powerful that everyone trembled.
The corners of Ge Hongqiu's mouth were cracked, and he let out a shrill scream.
"Ahhh...you trash, what are you doing?"
"I'm telling you, a bitch, to shut up! Does it feel good, hahaha..."
The other party was completely crazy. Zhou Tong had always doted on her and coaxed her, which made her develop a arrogant character.
Now Zhou Tong's attitude towards her took a turn for the worse, which made her instantly furious and pounced on him with all his teeth and claws.
"Hahaha... You really treat yourself like a dish. When I was good to you, you could say whatever you wanted. Now I don't care about you. You are nothing! Damn it!"
Even if Zhou Tong's cultivation level plummeted, his current strength was still not comparable to that of his opponent. He struck directly with a heavy hand and kicked his opponent in the abdomen.
Ge Hongqiu's eyeballs were protruded from the blow, and he flew backwards like a broken sack, falling miserably to the ground.
This scene deeply stimulated Jiang Yuyao on the side.
"Bold, do you know the gap between us? You are just a traitor now. Compared with us, we are in the sky and on the ground. To you, we are like gods!"
Jiang Yuyao roared angrily that she wanted Zhou Tong to know his identity clearly, there was no room for him to be arrogant here.
"You just save the fucking singer! You die too!"
Zhou Tong completely let go and expressed his feelings without giving any face. He grabbed Jiang Yuyao's hair, pressed her head and smashed her to the ground!
"Yes, you are just dreaming if you want me to let go!"
Everyone was stunned, having never seen such a violent Zhou Tong, and some could not help but tremble.
The space was distorted, and Mo Liusu, Chen Ling'er and Tang Qi suddenly appeared here.
Zhou Tong then stopped what he was doing and glanced at these people with a calm expression.
"If you dare to act cruel here, you have already committed a capital crime!"
The little demon girl stepped forward and said tit for tat: "These two bitches provoked the Hehuan Sect first. Even if they are beaten to death, they are to blame themselves. If you are not convinced, go and ask my master!"
As soon as these words came out, everyone immediately thought of the devil Murong Ya and couldn't help but shudder.
Although everyone said that the woman was exhausted, no one dared to offend her.
"Zhou Tong, you are too wanton! I am very disappointed in you."
Chen Ling'er said arrogantly: "You actually got together with the witch, you really let yourself down!"
"You're just a fool, why are you still teaching me?" Zhou Tong said disdainfully.
Chen Ling'er raised her pretty face: "How childish, didn't you just want to attract my attention by attacking the junior sisters? Now that I'm standing here, do you dare to hit me!"
As soon as these words came out, everyone around was stunned. They had never heard such a request.
Chen Ling'er's face was full of arrogance, and her eyebrows were looking down on her.
The reason why she dared to do this was precisely because she was confident. She could clearly feel that Zhou Tong once had a secret affection for her.
Otherwise, how could Zhou Tong abandon the little demon girl in the Hundred Sects Conference and rush to her side unconditionally?
If he didn't like it, how could Zhou Tong take the initiative to give up his training time and help her study the sword manual so that she could become the number one swordsman among the younger generation?
If it weren't for love, how could Zhou Tong be willing to consume spiritual energy to initiate her?
But so what? She originally had a cold temperament, as elegant as a snow lotus, and she was aloof from the world.
Moreover, she looked down upon Zhou Tong's undignified, groveling and cautious manner. In her eyes, there was only intention.The young junior brother who is full of energy and has an outstanding appearance is the real genius, an existence that is indomitable!
Even now, she thought Zhou Tong was playing hard to get, and she despised him even more.
Under the gaze of everyone, Zhou Tong rolled up his sleeves with a gentle smile and slapped that white face hard!
